title: 美联储官员称或需适度进一步收紧政策
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Coming into the summer, I was asking myself whether policy was restrictive enough to deliver 2% inflation or whether a somewhat higher federal funds rate might be needed.
segments.zh: 入夏时，我在思考政策是否足够限制性以实现2%通胀，还是需要略高的联邦基金利率。

segments.en: It was underlying inflation improving, where pressures from tariffs, energy, and AI staying contained, and where growth in the labor market consistent with some modest monetary policy restrictiveness.
segments.zh: 当时核心通胀在改善，关税、能源和AI带来的压力受控，劳动力市场增长与适度货币政策限制性相符。

segments.en: By September, it was clear that inflation risks were growing.
segments.zh: 到九月，通胀风险明显上升。

segments.en: Underlying inflation showed little to no progress.
segments.zh: 核心通胀几乎没有进展。

segments.en: Terror-related price pressures eased, but price pressures from the conflict in the Middle East and the AI build out grew.
segments.zh: 恐怖相关价格压力缓解，但中东冲突和AI建设带来的价格压力增加。

segments.en: Meanwhile, economic growth firmed up a little and the labor market strengthened to touch.
segments.zh: 同时，经济增长略有稳固，劳动力市场走强。

segments.en: Against this backdrop, the risk of persistently elevated inflation had increased.
segments.zh: 在此背景下，通胀持续高企的风险增加。

segments.en: And that's why I supported raising the federal funds rate by 25 basis points at last week's meeting.
segments.zh: 因此，我支持上周会议将联邦基金利率上调25个基点。

segments.en: This recalibration brings policy closer to what I believe is needed to return inflation to 2%, at a pace that appropriately balances inflation risks with risks to the labor market.
segments.zh: 这一调整使政策更接近我认为使通胀回到2%所需的水平，其步伐适当平衡了通胀风险与劳动力市场风险。

segments.en: Looking ahead, if conditions evolve as I expect, some modest further tightening may be warranted.
segments.zh: 展望未来，如果条件如我预期演变，可能需要进一步适度收紧。

segments.en: As always, I'll be watching the data and listening closely to what businesses and workers are telling me.
segments.zh: 一如既往，我会关注数据，并仔细倾听企业和员工的声音。
